store.description: A top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to six weapons at once. Survive the waves, stack upgrades and build the run that finally reaches wave 20.
features: Wave-based roguelite: survive 20 waves per run
Six weapon slots with hundreds of items and upgrades
WASD to move — your weapons fire on their own
Embedded client — no download, no account
Reload and Open-in-Browser toolbar if the frame is blocked
